name: howacademics
description: Informational academic book catalogue with admin management

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @howacademics/api && npm run typecheck -w @howacademics/web && npm run typecheck -w @howacademics/admin
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
